integrity: The proof uses the published finite-parameter inequality at unit scale as a premise and independently supplies the missing uniformity argument. Finite code checks only algebraic identities and is not used as proof of asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is qualitative for each fixed scale multiplier strictly above one: it does not compute the sharp gap, the minimizing degrees, or the approach-to-one asymptotics, and it is stated only for integer-degree central F laws.
title: Strict uniform half-mass gap above the mean for \(F\) distributions
